item.title: Here’s how much of Deutsche Bank’s market cap has been wiped away after reports on 15 million leaked documents
item.dc:creator: World Stock News Editorial Desk
item.description: Deutsche Bank saw as much as €3.8 billion ($4.2 billion) of its market cap wiped away after a team of media organizations wrote about a trove of 15 million leaked documents.
